rows.grounds: disjunctive particle offering an alternative means
locative adverb referring to this case

items.question: Can oblation alone secure the desired result without further deliberation?
premises: Oblation is presented as an effective means.
The desired object is obtained through this means.
Deliberation is explicitly negated in this context.
items.inference: Therefore, oblation suffices to obtain the desired result, and no further deliberation is required.
items.plain_english: Or from oblation one obtains what is desired; here no deliberation is to be made.
